svg.aria-label: Exact speculative decoding: guessed tokens are checked in one pass and only the ones the model agrees with are kept, so the text is the same as plain decoding. A small draft model: 1.4 times faster writing code; lookup: 3.2 times faster on agent tasks that copy text
svg.text: Guess a few tokens, check them all in one pass, keep only the ones the model agrees with: the same text as plain decoding, faster.
Plain decoding one token per step
With guesses a run of guesses checked in one pass
an illustration of the method; the numbers below are measured
